title: Vivumishi Viulizi (Theme 2: Michezo)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child gives -ngapi the noun's class prefix (mangapi, wangapi, vingapi), uses -pi for which one (lipi, kipi) and gani for what kind.
steps: Find the noun and its class.

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "mangapi" and a question with "kipi".

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Vitabu ___ vimepotea?" Kwa nini "wangapi" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kivumishi kiulizi huchukua ngeli ya nomino: wanafunzi wangapi, vitabu vingapi.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kitabu ___ ni chako?" Kwa nini "vipi" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kitabu kimoja: kipi. Vitabu vingi: vipi.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ulikula chakula ___ jana?" Kwa nini "wangapi" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: -ngapi huuliza idadi, -pi huuliza ni ipi kati ya nyingi, gani huuliza aina.
Sentensi yenye kiulizi huishia kwa alama ya kuuliza (?).
